name: frappe_assistant_core
description: Node dev dependencies for commit-message linting. Pinned to v19 because Frappe v15's bench environment uses Node 18, and commitlint v20's transitive deps require Node >=20. NOTE: the `build` script compiles the chat/frontend SPA, which requires Node >=22 (see frappe_assistant_core/chat/frontend/package.json engines) — run `bench build` on a bench whose Node is >=22.

scripts.build: cd frappe_assistant_core/chat/frontend && { [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci; } && npm run build
